bio: Mandy is the Chief Executive Officer, US and Americas, at Standard Chartered Bank. Mandy joined Standard Chartered in March 2025. Prior to her role at Standard Chartered, Mandy was a Managing Director and COO of Legal & Compliance, Risk and Operations at Citadel Securities.
